shots.visual: 山门前百名弟子拔剑齐指，林昭一步踏上石阶，剑尖在晨光里抖成一片寒芒。
shots.prompt_en: 100 disciples drawing swords, pointing blades forward, mountain gate, stone stairs, Lin Zhao stepping up, sword tip trembling, cold gleam, morning light, back view, tense standoff

shots.visual: 清晨青冥剑宗山门，晨雾未散，千级石阶直上云端，云海翻着金边。
shots.prompt_en: Qingming Sword Sect mountain gate at dawn, thousand stone steps ascending into clouds, sea of clouds with golden edges, lingering morning mist, soft dawn light

shots.visual: 数十名长老联手布下剑阵镇压，林昭抬手一记雷刀，剑阵如琉璃碎裂，光屑四散。
shots.prompt_en: many elders, sword formation, suppressing, Lin Zhao, raising hand, single lightning blade strike, sword array shattering like glass, light shards scattering, night battlefield, dramatic lightning glow

shots.visual: 严崇跌坐在碎剑堆里，铁面裂开一道缝，瞳孔放大，手撑着地面往后退。
shots.prompt_en: Yan Chong collapsed among shattered sword shards, iron mask cracked with a fissure, dilated pupils, hand pressing ground while retreating backward, dim cold light, dusty debris

shots.visual: 赵乾跪爬着扑到林昭脚边磕头，林昭目不斜视跨过他，靴底碾过一片碎玉。
shots.prompt_en: zhao qian kneeling crawling lunging at lin zhao's feet kowtowing, lin zhao striding past without looking, boot sole crushing shattered jade shards, stone courtyard, cold harsh light

shots.visual: 掌门玄尘子双膝跪地，额头磕在石阶上，抬头说话，晨光刺得他睁不开眼。
shots.dialogue: 玄尘子：你不是天弃之子……你是天道的备份。
shots.prompt_en: sect leader Xuan Chenzi, kneeling on both knees, forehead touching stone steps, looking up, speaking, squinting against light, stone staircase, morning sunlight, harsh glare
